scene.title: Roots of x² − 4x + 3
scene.summary: The quadratic x²−4x+3 factors to (x−1)(x−3), so its roots are x=1 and x=3.

beats.title: Plot the quadratic
beats.narration: We draw the curve y = x² − 4x + 3, an upward‑opening parabola.

beats.title: Find the vertex
beats.narration: The vertex is at x = 2, y = –1.

beats.title: Mark the roots
beats.narration: The curve crosses the x‑axis at x = 1 and x = 3.

beats.title: Factor form
beats.narration: Thus the quadratic factors as (x‑1)(x‑3), confirming the roots.
